stories.headline: Blackstone and Google form $5B TPU cloud JV, targeting 500 MW online by 2027

key_facts.fact: Blackstone and Google announced a US-based joint venture offering Google Cloud's TPUs as a compute-as-a-service offering, with an initial $5 billion equity commitment from Blackstone funds.
key_facts.excerpt: Blackstone (NYSE: BX) today announced a joint venture with Google to create a new U.S.-based company that will offer efficient data center capacity, operations, networking, and Google Cloud's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) as a compute-as-a-service offering... Blackstone is making an initial commitment of $5 billion in equity capital from funds managed by Blackstone.

key_facts.fact: The venture expects the first 500 MW of capacity to come online in 2027, with plans to scale significantly over time.
key_facts.excerpt: Blackstone to make initial $5 billion equity commitment to bring 500 MW of capacity online in 2027, with plans to scale significantly over time.

key_facts.fact: Blackstone named Benjamin Treynor Sloss, a Google executive with over two decades of experience building Google's global infrastructure, as CEO of the new company.
key_facts.excerpt: Blackstone has named Benjamin Treynor Sloss, a Google executive with over two decades of experience building and operating Google's global infrastructure and operations, to lead the new company as CEO.

key_facts.fact: Blackstone, which manages over $1.3 trillion in assets and is the largest global provider of data centers, would be a majority shareholder of the JV.
key_facts.excerpt: Blackstone said it will make an initial $5 billion equity investment through its funds. It expects the company's first 500 megawatts of power to come online by 2027. Though precise figures aren't disclosed, Blackstone would be a majority shareholder, according to a person familiar with the deal.

key_facts.fact: Thomas Kurian, CEO of Google Cloud, said the venture helps meet growing demand for TPUs by offering customers another way to access them beyond Google Cloud.
key_facts.excerpt: Thomas Kurian, chief executive of Google Cloud, said the venture would help address growing demand for TPUs by offering organisations additional ways to access computing capacity.

stories.headline: NextEra to buy Dominion for $67B in largest US utility deal, citing AI power demand

key_facts.fact: NextEra Energy agreed to acquire Dominion Energy in an all-stock deal valued at about $67 billion, the largest power acquisition in US history, creating the world's largest regulated electric utility.
key_facts.excerpt: NextEra Energy said Monday it will acquire Dominion Energy in an all-stock deal valued at about $67 billion... The all-stock transaction will create the 'largest regulated electric utility' in the world, the companies said Monday.

key_facts.fact: NextEra shareholders will own about 74.5% of the combined company; Dominion shareholders 25.5%. The merged utility will serve about 10 million customers across Florida, Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina.
key_facts.excerpt: NextEra Energy shareholders will own approximately 74.5% of the company while Dominion shareholders will own 25.5%. The combined company, which will operate under the name NextEra Energy, will serve around 10 million utility customers across Florida, Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina.

key_facts.fact: NextEra and Dominion together have roughly 130 GW of contracted data-center demand seeking grid connection, with Dominion alone holding nearly 51 GW of contracted data-center capacity from Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft and Meta.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal will enable a swifter build-out of power infrastructure to deliver electricity to data centres proposing to connect to NextEra and Dominion, which total about 130 gigawatts of electricity demand, the companies' executives said... Virginia-based [Dominion] has nearly 51 gigawatts of contracted data-centre capacity.

key_facts.fact: The companies pledged $2.25 billion in customer credits over two years to Dominion ratepayers in Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina as part of the deal.
key_facts.excerpt: As part of the deal, the companies said they would offer Dominion customers in Virginia, North Carolina and South Carolina a total of $2.25 billion in credits over two years.

key_facts.fact: US utilities and grid operators are expected to invest more than $1.1 trillion over the next five years on new generation and transmission projects.
key_facts.excerpt: Utilities and grid operators in the US are expected to invest more than $1.1 trillion over the next five years on new generation and transmission projects.

key_facts.fact: The deal is expected to close in mid-to-late 2027 (12-18 months).
key_facts.excerpt: The merger deal is expected to close in 12 to 18 months.

stories.headline: Analog Devices nears $1.5B all-cash deal for AI power-chip startup Empower Semiconductor

key_facts.fact: Analog Devices is in advanced talks to acquire Empower Semiconductor for approximately $1.5 billion in cash, with an announcement possible as early as Tuesday.
key_facts.excerpt: Semiconductor manufacturer Analog Devices is reportedly in advanced discussions to acquire AI-focused chipmaker Empower Semiconductor. The deal is estimated to be worth approximately $1.5 billion in cash... The acquisition could be announced as early as Tuesday.

key_facts.fact: Empower designs integrated voltage regulator ICs (the Crescendo family) that sit directly under GPUs and other AI accelerators, delivering more than 3,000 amps to AI processors.
key_facts.excerpt: Empower tries to solve some of the challenges with traditional power electronics with its latest family of voltage-regulator ICs called Crescendo. The technology relocates the active power delivery directly under the GPU or other AI accelerator, slinging more than 3,000 A of current up through the PCB instead of across it.

key_facts.fact: The deal would extend Analog Devices' acquisition streak — the company has done 16 acquisitions over the past decade, including the $20.9B Maxim Integrated takeout in 2021 and Flex Logix in November 2024.
key_facts.excerpt: This acquisition would follow the company's recent acquisition of Flex Logix in November 2024... In 2021, Analog Devices completed its landmark $20.9 billion acquisition of Maxim Integrated... Over the past decade, the company has completed 16 acquisitions.

key_facts.fact: Empower's solutions are already deployed in high-performance computing environments, and the acquisition aligns with ADI's push into AI infrastructure power management.
key_facts.excerpt: Empower specializes in advanced power management and integrated voltage regulator technology, which aims to reduce energy loss, improve processing efficiency, and increase computing density. The company's solutions are already being used in high-performance computing environments.

stories.headline: Tenstorrent draws early takeover interest from Intel and Qualcomm at $5B+ valuation

key_facts.fact: AI chip designer Tenstorrent has held early-stage takeover conversations with industry players including Intel and Qualcomm, according to Bloomberg sources.
key_facts.excerpt: Artificial intelligence chip startup Tenstorrent Inc. is drawing early takeover interest from prospective buyers at a moment of renewed momentum for upstarts looking to challenge Nvidia Corp. and Advanced Micro Devices Inc. Tenstorrent, which designs chips that it says are more efficient at running certain AI workloads, has held conversations with industry players including Intel Corp. and Qualcomm Inc., according to people familiar with the matter.

key_facts.fact: Tenstorrent could be valued at more than $5 billion in a potential deal.
key_facts.excerpt: Sources: AI chip designer Tenstorrent has drawn takeover interest from Intel and Qualcomm; Tenstorrent could be valued at more than $5B in a potential deal (Bloomberg)

key_facts.fact: Tenstorrent, led by veteran chip designer Jim Keller, was raising $800m at a $3.2bn pre-money valuation in November 2025, up from a $693m Series D closed in December 2024 at $2.6bn.
key_facts.excerpt: Tenstorrent, an AI chip startup led by Jim Keller, has reportedly held early-stage takeover discussions with Intel and Qualcomm, as it seeks to raise $800m at a $3.2bn pre-money valuation in November 2025, up from the $693m Series D it closed in December 2024 at $2.6bn.

key_facts.fact: The company designs RISC-V-based AI accelerators (Ascalon CPU cores and Tensix AI cores) sold both as packaged silicon and as licensable IP — a hybrid model that distinguishes it from pure chip startups.
key_facts.excerpt: The company designs RISC-V-based AI accelerators (Ascalon CPU cores and Tensix AI cores) that are sold both as packaged silicon and as licensable IP, a hybrid model for a chip startup.

key_facts.fact: Existing Tenstorrent investors include Bezos Expeditions, LG Electronics, Baillie Gifford, Hyundai Motor Group, Samsung Securities, AFW Partners, Fidelity, and the Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Securities and AFW Partners led the round. Jeff Bezos' Bezos Expeditions, Fidelity Management & Research Co. and LG Electronics also joined the funding for Tenstorrent... Export Development Canada, Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan, Hyundai Motor Group, Baillie Gifford and other investors also participated in the deal.

stories.headline: Seagate plunges nearly 7% as CEO rules out new factories, drags memory chip stocks down

key_facts.fact: Seagate shares closed down about 6.9% on Monday, leading a sector-wide sell-off, after CEO Dave Mosley said at the JPMorgan Global Technology, Media and Communications Conference that building new factories would 'take too long.'
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of memory chip maker Seagate closed down more than 6% Monday, leading a group-wide sell-off, after comments from CEO Dave Mosley raised concerns that it won't be able to meet the soaring demand fueled by the artificial intelligence buildout.

key_facts.fact: Mosley said critical components like recording head wafers have lead times exceeding nine months, with drives taking an additional quarter, and that demand 'significantly exceeds' current supply.
key_facts.excerpt: Mosley explained that Seagate's critical components, particularly recording head wafers, have lead times exceeding nine months, with drives taking an additional quarter to produce... Mosley noted that demand significantly exceeds the company's current supply, with customers seeking more exabytes.

key_facts.fact: The sell-off extended across memory peers Micron, SanDisk and Western Digital, as well as Power Integrations and FormFactor.
key_facts.excerpt: Shares of memory chip maker Seagate slipped, leading a group-wide sell-off, after comments from its CEO raised concerns that it won't be able to meet demand. Micron shares sank, along with both SanDisk and Western Digital.

key_facts.fact: Seagate is targeting mid-20s percent CAGR by advancing from 3 TB-per-platter to 4 and 5 TB-per-platter products rather than greenfield capacity additions, with Q3 non-GAAP gross margin hitting an all-time high of 47.0%.
key_facts.excerpt: The CEO said Seagate is targeting mid-20s percent CAGR growth by advancing through technology transitions, moving from 3 terabyte per platter products to 4 and 5 terabytes per platter.

key_facts.fact: Seagate has moved to a build-to-order model and currently provides customers with four to five quarters of forward visibility on supply.
key_facts.excerpt: We know what's coming out a year from now... So we want to keep that four or five quarters of visibility very, very solid for what's being built. But the demand is significantly higher than that.

stories.headline: Intel pushes US/China/Taiwan PC makers to use more 18A CPUs amid AI-driven supply crunch

key_facts.fact: Intel is asking leading PC partners in the US, China and Taiwan to increase use of CPUs built with its 18A process, citing better supply than older-node chips, Nikkei Asia reported.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel is pushing notebook and PC manufacturers to adopt central processing units built with its most advanced chip production technology as surging demand for AI computing power strains supplies of the key component, Nikkei Asia reported on Tuesday. The chipmaker is asking leading PC partners in the U.S., China and Taiwan to increase their use of CPUs built with the company's 18A production process.

key_facts.fact: Intel specifically cited better supply on its Panther Lake and Wildcat Lake CPU lines, which run on 18A, versus older-node parts.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel told partners that supply of cutting-edge CPUs, specifically the Panther Lake and Wildcat Lake lines, is better than that of processors based on older chipmaking technologies, according to the report.

key_facts.fact: CEO Lip-Bu Tan said separately on Monday that Intel expects 'multiple' external foundry customer commitments in the second half of the year, with 18A improvements drawing growing customer interest.
key_facts.excerpt: Tan pointed to improvements in Intel's advanced 18A manufacturing process... The improvements are beginning to draw customer interest, according to Tan... Tan said Intel expects commitments from multiple foundry customers in the second half of the year. 'Multiple customers, they are working with us,' he said.

key_facts.fact: Intel has built a new 18A plant in Arizona, while a separate Ohio project has faced major delays and is not expected to start production until at least 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel has built a new plant in Arizona, where it uses the 18A process, while a separate project in Ohio has faced major delays and isn't set to start production until at least 2030.

stories.headline: Kia to deploy Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid first in Georgia assembly plants

key_facts.fact: Kia President Song Ho-sung said on Monday during overseas non-deal roadshow meetings in Singapore and Hong Kong that the company plans to deploy Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid robot first in difficult and physically demanding assembly processes.
key_facts.excerpt: Kia President Song Ho-sung said the company plans to deploy the humanoid robot Atlas first in difficult and physically demanding assembly processes at its factories. Song made the remarks during overseas non-deal roadshow meetings in Singapore and Hong Kong, industry sources said Monday.

key_facts.fact: Atlas will be deployed first at Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America in Georgia, and a year later at Kia's Georgia plant, because the production systems and factory structures are the same.
key_facts.excerpt: 'Atlas will first be deployed at Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America in Georgia, and a year later at Kia's Georgia plant,' Song said. 'Because the production systems and factory structures are the same, once Atlas can be used in one production process, it can be applied the same way at other plants.'

key_facts.fact: Hyundai Motor Group is building a humanoid mass production system with annual capacity of 30,000 units by 2028, with deployments at Hyundai Metaplant America starting in 2028 and at Kia's Georgia plant in 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: Hyundai Motor is building a mass production system for humanoid robots with an annual capacity of 30,000 units by 2028. The company plans to begin deploying humanoids at Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America in 2028 and at Kia's Georgia plant in 2029.

key_facts.fact: The disclosure also raised speculation about a potential IPO for Boston Dynamics, the US robotics company owned by Hyundai Motor Group.
key_facts.excerpt: The possible deployment of Atlas has also drawn attention to whether Boston Dynamics, the U.S. robotics company owned by Hyundai Motor Group, could pursue an initial public offering.
